title: A denser optical path
hook: Change refractive index and predict optical path length.
misconception: optical path length stays fixed when refractive index doubles.
objective: Apply OPL = nL to compare optical path length when refractive index changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a uniform transparent medium with fixed geometric path length, OPL = nL. When refractive index doubles, optical path length becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model OPL = nL; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a uniform transparent medium with fixed geometric path length, with a nonzero initial result. If refractive index triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on optical path length?
recall.why: Apply OPL = nL under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
